versions.changelog:
Initial release of "academic-paper-writer" skill for guided academic writing.

- Assists with drafting, revising, and completing IMRaD sections of scientific papers using structured prompts.
- Integrates citation lookup from local Zotero and complements with PubMed/high-quality sources when needed.
- Supports citation insertion and formatting (Vancouver/APA), with end-to-end reference management and export.
- Enforces quality rules: no fabricated citations, precise clinical language, and explicit handling of data claims.
- Interactive iterative workflow: collects context, proposes drafts, incorporates feedback, and maintains session context for coherence.
- Designed for use by Juan Antonio in the `workspace-jd` environment, with special features for nephrology and clinical writing integration.
